arguments.text: Let the pack go, settle to your own steady pace.

text: let_go: holding the pack took 182 W shaft (sustainable 158 W, reserve empties in 1.5 km) and the wash was fading anyway.

arguments.text: Let this group go, settle to your own steady pace.

text: no cue (blocked by cooldown): wanted let_go, the wash takes 171 W shaft vs 158 W sustainable, reserve would empty in 2.2 km.

arguments.text: Off the wash now, ease a touch, settle at 2:47.

text: ease to 2:47: no wash left (local push equals current), 170 W shaft vs 156 W sustainable empties the pod reserve in 1.6 km of 5 km.

arguments.text: Stop chasing, let them go, settle to your own pace.

text: let_go: 171 W shaft held 5 min with no wash, fade 4 pct, pod reserve 27 pct empties in 690 m with 4.1 km left.
no cue: shaft power already falling (170 to 166 W) toward the 152 W sustainable level; let it settle.

arguments.text: Ease off now, settle at 2:59, save it for the sprint.

text: ease to 2:59: 168 W shaft vs 152 W sustainable, pod reserve 18 pct empties in 540 m of 3.9 km, fade near 5 pct.

arguments.text: Rate down two, lengthen each stroke, stay relaxed.

text: rate_down: lasting 7 pct fade at an unchanged rate of 66, and 156 W shaft slightly above the 151 W sustainable with the pod reserve at 8 pct.

arguments.text: Rate down two, long relaxed strokes out of the turn.

text: no cue (cooldown, a cue went out 10 s ago): wanted rate_down for the lasting 7 pct fade.

arguments.text: Rate down two strokes, longer cleaner pulls, keep the power.

text: rate_down: speed through the water down 11 pct at the same rate 66 while power holds near 170 W, so the rate is now too high for this tired paddler.
no cue: power fell from 171 to 134 W after the pod reserve sat at zero for minutes, a forced slowdown; pushing a spent paddler now would cost more, let the reserve rebuild for the finish.
no cue: pod reserve hit zero again 2 min ago and power dropped to 132 W, a forced slowdown; let it rebuild and save what returns for the final sprint.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, hold 3:02 steady, sprint comes later.

text: ease to 3:02: 160 W shaft vs 152 W sustainable empties the 5 pct pod reserve in 265 m with 1 km left; avoid another crash, sprint from what is left.

arguments.text: Final sprint now, everything left to the line.

text: finish: 285 m left, the pod reserve (6.5 pct) supports about 160 W to the line, so spend it now.
